title_en: Demon Slayer × ufotable Cafe "Musunda En" — Full Series Rerun Collaboration (March-May 2026)
title_ja: テレビアニメ 鬼滅の刃 シリーズ全編再放送 コラボレーションカフェ 〜結んだ縁〜
description_en: ufotable's in-house cafe network celebrates the Demon Slayer full-series rerun with "Musunda En" (Bonds Forged) from March 31 to May 6, 2026, across Tokyo Nakano, Nagoya, Osaka Namba, Tokushima, and Kitakyushu. Lottery reservation, themed novelty food and drink, and character-pair beverages.

venues.name: ufotable Cafe Tokushima
venues.address: 1-13 Higashifunaba-cho, Tokushima, Tokushima, Kokusai Higashifunaba 113 Building 2F

venues.name: ufotable Cafe Kitakyushu
venues.address: 2-14-5 Asano, Kokurakita-ku, Kitakyushu, Fukuoka, aruaru City 2F

reservation_summary: Lottery-based advance reservation via the ufotable cafe portal. Slots release per cafe and competition is fierce; book via Lawson Loppi as an alternative where applicable.
merch_bonus: Novelty coaster, sticker, or acrylic charm per food or drink ordered. Relationship-themed drink series pairs Tanjiro with Nezuko, Giyu, Urokodaki, Sabito, Makomo, Zenitsu, Genya, and Kanao.
menu_highlights: Kamado-ke no Sumibiyaki Tori Don (Kamado Family charcoal-grilled chicken bowl) — ¥1,400
Tanjiro to Doki-tachi Saishu-senbetsu Salad (Final Selection Salad) — ¥1,300
Urokodaki Ichimon Mizu no Kokyu Parfait (Water Breathing parfait) — ¥1,200
Urokodaki Ichimon Saigo no Shiren (Urokodaki school final trial plate) — ¥1,300
Character-pair drinks (Tanjiro × Nezuko / Giyu / Urokodaki / Sabito / Makomo / Zenitsu / Genya / Kanao) — ¥650 each

title_en: DARK MOON: THE BLOOD ALTAR × THE Chara Cafe Ikebukuro (April-May 2026)
title_ja: DARK MOON: THE BLOOD ALTAR THEキャラCAFE
description_en: HYBE's webtoon-anime DARK MOON takes over THE Chara Cafe Ikebukuro inside Grand Scape Ikebukuro 2F from April 25 to May 6, 2026. Character image-color drinks (¥880), hamburger and pasta dishes, and random coaster or bromide bonuses.

venues.name: THE Chara CAFE Ikebukuro (Grand Scape Ikebukuro 2F)
venues.address: 1-30-3 Higashi-Ikebukuro, Toshima-ku, Tokyo, Grand Scape Ikebukuro 2F
venues.station: Ikebukuro Station East Exit, 4 min walk

merch_bonus: Random coaster (7 variants) with each drink; random large bromide (7 variants) with food or dessert orders.

title_en: The Apothecary Diaries × and GALLERY Collaboration Cafe (April-May 2026)
title_ja: 薬屋のひとりごと and GALLERY コラボカフェ
description_en: The Apothecary Diaries takes over and GALLERY locations in Ikebukuro, Osaka Namba, and Nagoya from April 4 to May 6, 2026. Chinese-inspired menu featuring Maomao's signature dishes (¥1,000–¥1,500) and Jinshi's honey-fried duck wrap. Web-advance seat reservation opened March 28, walk-ins accepted as space permits.

venues.name: and GALLERY Ikebukuro
venues.address: 1-5-7 Higashi-Ikebukuro, Toshima-ku, Tokyo, LABI1 LIFE SELECT Ikebukuro 7F

venues.name: and GALLERY Nagoya
venues.address: 3-30-40 Osu, Naka-ku, Nagoya, Aichi, Manshoji Building 1F

reservation_summary: Advance web reservation opened March 28, 18:00. Walk-ins accepted as space permits. Reservation bonus (die-cut sticker) available.
merch_bonus: Menu order bonus: coaster. Merch purchase bonus: die-cut sticker. Advance reservation bonus available. Trading pins ¥550 (10 variants), clear cards ¥550 (10 variants), mini acrylic stands ¥850 (8 variants), large acrylic stands ¥1,650 (2 variants).
menu_highlights: Maomao's Shoutoubao Plate (¥1,500; ¥3,000 with souvenir plate)
Jinshi's Honey Fried Chicken & Roast Duck Wrap (¥1,500)
Parfait A and Parfait B (¥1,200 each)

title_en: Okami 20th Anniversary Cafe × Monster Hunter Sakaba (April-June 2026)
title_ja: 大神 20周年 モンハン酒場 コラボカフェ
description_en: Capcom's Okami celebrates its 20th anniversary with a collaboration cafe at Monster Hunter Sakaba, running April 20 to June 1, 2026. Amaterasu and Sakuya themed dishes at two venues — Akihabara Pasela 3F and Osaka Dotonbori 4F — plus a random 8-variant coaster per menu order.

venues.name: Monster Hunter Sakaba Akihabara (Pasela Resorts AKIBA 3F)
venues.address: 1-1-10 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo 101-0021, Pasela Resorts AKIBA Multi Entertainment 3F

venues.name: Monster Hunter Sakaba WEST (Pasela Resorts Namba Dotonbori 4F)
venues.address: 1-4-27 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka 542-0071, Pasela Resorts Namba Dotonbori 4F

reservation_summary: Advance web reservation required via Pasela. Both venues operate on the Pasela booking platform; book directly on the pasela.co.jp portal.
merch_bonus: Random original coaster (8 variants) per menu order. Free limited postcard with purchases of 3,000 yen or more.
menu_highlights: Fude-shirabe Kidama niku-dango no tomato cream pasta (brush-stroke Radiant Jewel meatball tomato cream pasta)
Mikan-jii tokusei mikan juice (Mikan-jii's special mikan juice)
